# jsonschema and what it needs, pinned by hash: core-and-tests runs
# SchemaFixturesTest (tests/schema_fixtures.py) with it, so the committed
# fixtures are checked against schema/ in CI. The pure-Python wheels, and
# rpds-py's manylinux x86_64 wheels for CPython 3.12 (ubuntu-latest,
# Ubuntu 24.04), 3.13 and 3.14. typing-extensions is referencing's below
# Python 3.13. Bumped by hand: take each wheel's sha256 from
# https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json and check the set with
# pip install --require-hashes in a scratch venv.
